title: Maximize Sum of Device Ratings
summary: Given a 2D integer array units where each element represents the capacity of a unit in a device, the rating of a device is defined as the minimum capacity among all its units.
statement: Given a 2D integer array units where each element represents the capacity of a unit in a device, the rating of a device is defined as the minimum capacity among all its units. You are allowed to perform the following operation any number of times: - Choose an unused device and remove exactly one unit from it. - Add the removed unit to any other device. - Mark the chosen device as used, so it cannot be selected again. The task is to maximize the sum of the ratings of all devices after performing these operations. Note that devices can receive units from multiple sources, and an empty device has a rating of 0.
constraints: units is a nonempty rectangular matrix of positive capacities.
A device rating is its minimum unit, or zero if empty; each device may donate one unit at most once to another device.
Return the maximum possible sum of device ratings.
hints: Every donating device can remove its smallest unit and raise its rating to its second smallest.
All removed minima may be placed into one receiver, whose final rating is the global smallest removed value.
Sum all second minima, then replace the smallest second minimum with the global first minimum.
Choosing the receiver with smallest second minimum minimizes the sacrificed gain; no other move can raise a donor beyond its second minimum.
editorial: Choosing the receiver with smallest second minimum minimizes the sacrificed gain; no other move can raise a donor beyond its second minimum.

tests.explanation: Move the one from the first device; its remaining rating three plus the recipient rating one totals four.
No transfer improves the existing rating sum six.
